items.author: talljack
items.descZh: Menu Hub 是一款基于 Swift 6、SwiftUI 和 AppKit 构建的原生 macOS 菜单栏管理工具，致力于为用户提供深度且流畅的系统状态栏定制体验。在最新发布的 v0.1.5 版本中，应用带来了显著的视觉升级，核心重构了项目操作面板，并引入了极具质感的“液态玻璃”（liquid glass）动态特效，大幅提升了界面美观度与交互细节。凭借其纯原生技术栈，该工具在实现高度系统集成的同时，也能保持极低的资源占用和极高的运行效率。它非常适合那些追求高效桌面工作流、喜欢深度个性化定制菜单栏图标及交互的 Mac 用户与开发者。
items.quote: 原生macOS菜单栏管理器，使用Swift 6，SwiftUI和AppKit构建。

items.author: oldzoomer
items.descZh: nodehistj 是一款专为处理和管理历史 FidoNet 节点列表数据而设计的系统，旨在帮助用户保存、分析和追溯早期 BBS 网络时代的节点拓扑变迁。系统核心由节点列表下载模块、历史数据存档模块以及差异对比工具组成，底层依赖 PostgreSQL 数据库进行高效且稳定的数据持久化存储。在技术实现上，该项目采用 Gradle 构建工具与 Kotlin 脚本进行自动化数据处理，并提供完善的 Docker 容器化部署方案（集成 Traefik 反向代理），代码库累计达 786 次提交，开发活跃度高。该工具非常适合数字档案馆员、复古计算爱好者以及网络历史研究者，用于挖掘历史网络节点变化、重建旧时网络路由或开展去中心化网络的历史演化研究。
items.quote: 用于处理历史 FidoNet 节点列表数据的系统。

files Repository files navigation Next Notes Pushtotalk dictation for macOS. Hold a key, talk, release — cleanedup text lands in the app you were already in. A Wispr Flowshaped app, built native and fully ondevice. [](/spyhack225/nextnotes/blob/main/site/public/demodictation.gif) Status: the macOS app is in daily use. It supports Apple and Parakeet transcription, deterministic or ondevice LLM cleanup, perapp output formatting, personal dictionary bias and corrections, and an optin voice Command Mode for editing selected text. Dictated text returns to the app it was started in, even if you switch away while the model is still working. It also records meetings: the microphone and the system's own output are captured as two separate tracks and transcribed separately, which is where the "You" and "Others" attribution in a meeting transcript comes from. A finished recording then walks itself the rest of the way — tell the speakers on the system track apart, write Granolastyle notes with a local LLM, and offer followup actions in Gmail, Calendar, Drive and Docs that only happen if you approve them. Everything runs on this Mac; the only network traffic is a model download, your own calendar, and a Workspace action you approved. The Windows app builds and is exercised in CI, but has not yet been used for a real microphone/key/injection session on Windows hardware. Meetings record themselves by default. Once Calendar access is granted, Next Notes reads your calendars (Apple Calendar through EventKit, and optionally Google Calendar through its API), and any event that looks like a real meeting — a conference link or at least one other attendee, not allday, not declined — is armed a minute before it starts and recorded when it does. It announces itself first with a notification carrying Record now and Skip, every event has its own Record checkbox in the Upcoming list, and the whole behaviour is one switch in Settings ▸ Meetings (_Record calendar meetings automatically_, with the lead time beside it). Turn that off and meetings only record when you press the button. A call nobody put on a calendar arms the same card. items.author: Sergekad0
items.descZh: Next Notes 是一款针对 macOS 设计的本地优先语音输入与会议记录工具，融合了类似 Wispr Flow 的语音转写与 Granola 的会议纪要功能，确保所有数据完全留在本地 Mac 设备上。其核心语音输入支持按键 speaking 模式，利用 Apple 或 Parakeet 进行本地转录，并通过本地 LLM 进行文本清理与跨应用格式化注入，即使切换应用也能返回原应用。会议记录方面，它通过分离麦克风与系统输出轨道实现“你”与“他人”的发言区分，并自动生成 Granola 风格的本地纪要，同时支持在授权后自动在 Gmail、日历和文档中创建后续任务。软件能自动读取日历并提前一分钟自动配置会议录制，提供一键跳过或录制选项，且整个过程除模型下载和授权操作外无其他网络流量。该工具适用于追求高隐私、高频语音输入及需要高效本地会议整理的用户，目前 macOS 版已投入日常使用，Windows 版仅完成 CI 构建。
items.quote: 专为 macOS 设计的听写与会议笔记功能，数据绝不离开你的 Mac。
items.titleZh: Show HN: Next Notes – 本地听写、会议记录和行动应用

items.title: Show HN: TUI Markdown reader with beeline support
items.desc: Rust fast TUI markdown reader for the terminal. Pastel themed BeeLine gradients for line tracking, mouse scroll + hover URL previews, keyboard-first navigation, and support tables and code blocks.
items.author: seymores
items.descZh: 这是一款基于 Rust 语言构建的极速终端 Markdown 阅读器，旨在为终端用户提供流畅、低延迟的文档渲染体验。工具的核心功能包括对表格和代码块的全面支持，以及键盘优先的快速导航，满足开发者对高效操作的需求。其视觉亮点在于采用了 Pastel 色调的 BeeLine 渐变行追踪技术，结合鼠标滚轮滚动与悬停 URL 预览功能，实现了极佳的视觉引导与直观的交互体验。该阅读器通过 Rust 的高性能特性保障了处理大文件时的快速响应。它特别适用于需要在终端环境下深度阅读技术文档、代码库及复杂表格的专业开发者和技术写作者。
items.quote: 适用于终端的 Rust 快速 TUI Markdown 阅读器。支持用于行跟踪的粉彩主题 BeeLine 渐变、鼠标滚动与悬停 URL 预览、键盘优先导航。

[](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Graphify.CSharp) [](https://github.com/zachsaw/graphifycsharp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](/zachsaw/graphifycsharp/blob/main/LICENSE) graphifycsharp is a free, headless Roslyn/MSBuild indexer that turns C source into deterministic, queryable semantic evidence: compilerresolved callers, references, implementations, inheritance, and overrides—even across overloads, generics, and projects. Think of it as the semanticnavigation slice of Rider/ReSharper, exported for Codex, Claude Code, and other coding agents. MIT licensed · No IDE · No compiled project DLL required · No database · Graphify optional Stop making your agent guess Suppose you ask: Which methods are used only by tests? A text search can find matching spellings. It cannot reliably tell which overload was bound, which project the caller belongs to, or whether an interface implementation is the symbol you meant. Graphify C loads the project through MSBuild and asks Roslyn what every symbol actually means. It emits stable identities and directed relationships that an agent can inspect instead of infer: Without semantic indexing With Graphify C Matching names look like usages Roslyn resolves the exact declaration Overloads and generics are ambiguous Bound signatures and project/TFM identity are retained Testonly usage requires manual inspection Every caller carries project, namespace, and source location Type relationships are reconstructed from text inherits, implements, and overrides are explicit edges For example, this repository contains an internal DeclarationCatalogBuilder.ForTesting(...) method. From the extracted graph, an agent can see one compilerresolved incoming call: Graphify.CSharp.Roslyn.DeclarationCatalogBuilder.ForTesting(...) └── called by Graphify.CSharp.Tests.Roslyn.CSharp14FeatureTests at tests/Graphify.CSharp.Tests/Roslyn/CSharp14FeatureTests.cs:143 That is semantic evidence, not a textmatch count. A consumer can classify the caller by project or namespace convention and report the method as testonly for human review. Quick start 1\. Install dotnet tool install global Graphify.CSharp framework net10.0 2\. Index your codebase graphifycsharp \ input ./src/MyProduct.sln \ root . \ configuration Release \ output ./graphifyout/csharp.json The result is one complete JSON document containing nodes, edges, and hyperedges. It can be read directly by an agent, queried with jq, consumed from your own code, or passed to Graphify. Supported inputs are .sln, .slnx, .csproj, and SDK filebased .cs apps. The repository's SDKs, packages, and MSBuild inputs must be available locally. 3\. Teach your agent to use it The included [graphifycsharp skill](/zachsaw/graphifycsharp/blob/main/.agents/skills/graphifycsharp/SKILL.md)teaches an agent when to refresh the index, how to follow semantic edges, and where static analysis stops. Install it in a Codexcompatible project: mkdir p .agents/skills/graphifycshar

[](https://rubygems.org/gems/omagem) [](/azzenabidi/OmaGem/blob/main/LICENSE) A small Ruby DSL for configuring and managing [Omarchy](https://omarchy.org/)Linux systems: themes, backgrounds, packages, services, the shell bar, plugins, toggles, snapshots, gitinstalled software, and system operations. It wraps the single omarchy CLI, so it stays in sync with the real command surface. Designed to be used both in scripts and inside a Rails application. Requirements Ruby 3.0+ An [Omarchy](https://omarchy.org/) system with the omarchy CLI on your PATH Installation As a dependency (Bundler) Add this line to your application's Gemfile: gem "omagem" Then execute: bundle install Or install directly from the repository: gem "omagem", github: "azzenabidi/OmaGem", branch: "main" Standalone (scripts and oneoff use) If you just want the DSL in a plain Ruby script or from the terminal: gem install omagem Verify the gem is installed and loadable: ruby e 'require "omagem"; puts OmaGem::VERSION' Uninstalling Remove from a Bundler project bundle remove omagem (Or delete the gem "omagem" line from your Gemfile and run bundle install.) Uninstall the gem gem uninstall omagem To remove it from every RubyGems environment on the machine: gem uninstall omagem all Usage require "omagem" OmaGem.run do theme "catppuccin" background "/home/me/Pictures/forest.png" add_packages "docker", "git" add_packages "yaybin", aur: true install_service "tailscale" install_dev_env "ruby" install_browser "firefox" nightlight :on touchpad :on bar_set "omarchy.clock", "format", "HH:mm" clone_plugin "omarchy.workspaces" update(yes: false) end Every method is documented on OmaGem::Config. The block is evaluated against a fresh Config, so you can call any DSL method directly: config = OmaGem.run do theme "catppuccin" add_packages "git" end config.executed = [["theme", "set", "catppuccin"], ["pkg", "add", "git"]] config.client.run("theme", "current").stdout raw command passthrough DSL reference Themes & backgrounds theme "catppuccin" apply a theme ("Tokyo Night" or "tokyonight" both work) themes list available themes install_theme "https://...git" install from a git repo remove_theme "mytheme" remove a userinstalled theme refresh_theme reapply current theme from templates update_themes update installed git themes background "/path/to/image.png" set the desktop background background_next cycle to next background background_switcher open the background switcher Packages add_packages "docker", "git" install Arch packages if missing add_packages "yaybin", aur: true install from the AUR drop_packages "vim" remove packages if installed package_present?("docker") true unless ALL listed are installed package_installed?("docker", "git") true when ALL listed are installed Services, apps, tools install_service "tailscale" 1password, dropbox, nordvpn, once, signal, spotify, sunshine, tailscale remove_service "tailscale" install_browser "firefox" chrome, brave, braveorigin, edge, firefox, zen install_editor "helix" emacs, helix, vscode, zed install_terminal "kitty" alacritty, foot, ghostty, kitty install_dev_env "ruby" ruby, node, bun, deno, go, laravel, symfony, php, python, elixir, phoenix, rust, java, zig, ocaml, dotnet, clojure, scala instal
items.author: azzen
items.descZh: OmaGem 是一款专为 Omarchy Linux 系统打造的 Ruby 领域特定语言（DSL）工具，旨在通过声明式的 Ruby 代码替代繁琐的终端命令，实现系统配置与管理的自动化。核心功能上，它封装了单一的 `omarchy` CLI 接口，支持对主题、背景、软件包、服务、开发环境、插件及快照等系统组件进行精细控制，并确保与真实命令表面实时同步。该工具亮点在于其高度抽象的配置块设计（支持直接调用 DSL 方法或通过原始命令透传交互），且完美兼容 Ruby 3.0+ 环境。它既可作为独立脚本通过 `gem install` 快速部署，也能作为依赖项无缝嵌入 Rails 应用程序中，为开发者提供了一套高效、可复用的 Linux 环境配置解决方案。
items.quote: 一个用于配置和管理 Omarchy Linux 系统的小型 Ruby DSL：主题、背景、软件包、服务、shell 栏、插件、开关、快照、gitins。

items.descZh: 近年来，语音克隆技术从实验室走向实用，得益于大规模数据集和神经网络模型的进步，使得从极短音频中复制人类声音成为可能。该工具通过深度学习模型从短音频片段中提取说话人的声学特征，实现高精度的语音克隆，并支持任意文本的语音生成。仅需3秒音频即可完成克隆，生成语音的自然度MOS评分超过4.5，支持实时合成且延迟低于100毫秒，同时兼容多种语言和情感表达。适用于个性化语音助手、有声内容制作、无障碍辅助技术、语言学习以及跨语言配音等多个领域。
